sloka: विश्वकर्मा च दृष्ट्वैनं बालसूर्योपमं शिशुम् ।शिल्पिनां प्रवरः प्रादाद्वरमस्य महामतिः ।। ७.३६.२० ॥
transliteration: viśvakarmā ca dṛṣṭvainaṁ bālasūryopamaṁ śiśum ।śilpināṁ pravaraḥ prādādvaramasya mahāmatiḥ ।। 7.36.20 ॥

translations.english: And Vishwakarma, the great-minded and foremost of artisans, having seen the child who resembled the rising sun, granted him a boon.
